top: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap in mercy;
bottom: ...for it is time to seek the LORD...

top: I will be as the dew unto Israel:
bottom: he shall grow as the lily...

bottom: the years that the locust hath eaten...

top: But let judgment run down as waters,
